# Quartic interaction generated by a sextic interaction

↑ **Parent:** [Momentum-shell renormalization group](momentum-shell-renormalization-group.md)

Splitting a [scalar field](scalar-field.md) into slow and fast components $\phi=\varphi+\eta$, the [Wick contractions](wick-contraction.md) in $\lambda\langle(\varphi+\eta)^6\rangle$ generate $15\lambda\langle\eta^2\rangle\varphi^4$. A vanishing bare quartic coupling is therefore not generally preserved by [renormalization-group flow](renormalization-group-flow.md).
